strings.name: Slavoj Žižek
strings.summary: Žižek studied philosophy in Ljubljana and psychoanalysis in Paris, drawing on Hegel, Marx and Lacan to examine ideology. He brought films, jokes and popular culture into theory and gained influence through translations, lectures and media. His politics and provocative rhetoric draw debate. In 2014 unattributed passages were criticized; he said he used a friend’s summary and expressed regret. He served as Birkbeck humanities institute international director until 2025.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through November 13, 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Examined ideology through philosophy, psychoanalysis and popular culture criticism, generating theoretical circulation across languages and public intellectual influence.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f1.value: Ljubljana, Yugoslavia, now Slovenia’s capital; born March 21, 1949.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Ideology criticism
strings.highlights.h1.text: Combines Lacanian psychoanalysis and German idealism, using cultural examples to explain ideology’s operation.
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Ljubljana philosophy MA (1975) and PhD (1981); also earned a psychoanalysis doctorate at Paris 8.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Public thought across languages
strings.highlights.h2.text: Brings theory into public debate through books, film discussions and lectures; his political judgments prompt criticism and responses.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Birkbeck directorship ended
strings.timeline.t1.text: The institute records his international directorship ending in mid-September 2025.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Christian Atheism published
strings.timeline.t2.text: Discussed Christianity, atheism and materialism through Hegel, Marx and Lacan.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Unattributed text controversy
strings.timeline.t3.text: Uncredited passages in a 2006 essay were exposed; he said they came from a friend’s summary and expressed regret.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Less Than Nothing published
strings.timeline.t4.text: Published an extensive philosophical argument centered on Hegel and dialectical materialism.
strings.timeline.t5.title: The Sublime Object of Ideology
strings.timeline.t5.text: The English-language book brought psychoanalysis and ideology criticism to a broader readership.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Founded theoretical psychoanalysis society
strings.timeline.t6.text: Organized the Ljubljana society to develop discussion of Lacanian theory.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Philosophy doctorate
strings.timeline.t7.text: Completed Ljubljana doctoral work on German idealism and psychoanalysis.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Philosophy master’s degree
strings.timeline.t8.text: Completed a Ljubljana master’s degree researching French structuralism.
